units.source_text: 他战战兢兢地抬起眼睛望了望……

en.t: He timidly raised his eyes and took a look...

units.source_text: 稀薄的光中，瞭望哨看上去很奇怪，摇摇欲坠。

en.t: In the thin light, the lookout post looked strange, as if it might collapse at any moment.

units.source_text: 意外地虚弱，距离也很远。

en.t: It seemed unexpectedly frail, and it was very far away as well.

units.source_text: 但是对方是用望远镜观望的，所以，不能寄希望于距离。

en.t: But the other side was watching through binoculars, so he could not place any hope in the distance.
Had he probably already been discovered?...

units.source_text: 不会吧，要是注意到了，一定会马上敲钟的。

en.t: No, surely not; if they had noticed him, they would definitely ring the bell at once.
